source_document.body:
We’ve got an exciting Tuesday Green Deals edition with two new launches and a first-time discount. Leading the pack is the official launch of Anker’s SOLIX S5000 Portable Power Station + bundles that our readers can get up to $2,150 exclusive savings on starting from $2,375 . Right behind that is the all-new XP Lite3 Lightweight Folding e-bikes from Lectric with up to $356 FREE bundled gear starting from $799 . There’s also a major first-time discount ($130 off) on the Baseus U2 Pro 3K Dual-Lens AI Solar Outdoor Security Camera for $150 , as well as an Autel 50A Level 2 EV Charger at $143 off. Of course, you can also find yesterday’s hangover deals at the bottom of the page, including the Bluetti Halloween Sale lineup with exclusive savings, the premium EGO 22-inch Select Cut + Touch Drive mower kit with a 10.0Ah battery at its best price of the year, and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Anker launches ‘world’s longest-lasting 5kWh’ S5000 power station at up to $2,150 off for our readers
Anker has officially launched its newest S5000 5,024Wh Portable Power Station that also benefits from our exclusive bonus savings code 9TO5DEALS5 to drop down to $2,375 shipped , beating out Amazon’s launch pricing by $123 . This all-new model will fetch $3,600 in full once the launch deals end, with it starting off here at $2,500 for $1,100 savings that get all the better with our code, which combines for a total $1,225 savings. Of course, if you jumped on the early-bird offer that was running up until yesterday you’ll also be getting a FREE bonus bundle worth $699. One thing the brand is offering is a special launch gift, with a box at the bottom of the landing page where you can type in your order number after checkout (while being logged in as a member) to claim.
You can get the full rundown on this new station’s features in our original launch coverage here , while we have listed its bundle deals below.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
***Note: All the prices you see below have had our bonus extra savings factored in, so make sure to use our exclusive code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout for the absolute best deals during this launch event.
Anker’s SOLIX S5000 power station launch bundle deals:
S5000 (5,024Wh) power station: $2,375 (Reg. $3,600)
S5000 (5,024Wh) with 240V fast-charging cable: $2,451 (Reg. $3,700)
S5000 (5,024Wh) with 400W Bifacial solar panel: $2,850 (Reg. $4,400)
S5000 (10,048Wh) with expansion battery: $4,275 (Reg. $6,100)
S5000 (10kWh) with expansion battery + 400W solar panel: $4,750 (Reg. $6,900)
Lectric launches XP Lite3 folding e-bikes with up to $356 FREE gear starting from $799
Lectric has just launched its new-gen XP Lite3 Lightweight Folding e-bikes starting from $799 shipped (with no bundles), while the long-range model gets a FREE $257 bundle at $999 shipped and the long-range belt-drive model (now with two colorway options) get a FREE $356 bundle at $1,099 shipped . The models getting bundles would cost you $1,256 and $1,455 without the discounts on the included gear. Those bundles include a fender set, Elite headlight, and suspension seatpost for the standard long-range options, while the JW belt-drive options get an additional LevelUp Lite cargo rack. It is expected to begin shipping the week of November 9, 2026.
You can get a breakdown of the XP Lite3’s features in our coverage of this deal here .
Major 46% price drop hits new Baseus security cam with dual 3K design, solar power, spotlight, more at $150
Through the official Baseus Amazon storefront you can now get the first savings on the brand’s latest U2 Pro 3K Dual-Lens AI Solar Outdoor Security Camera first discount for $149.99 shipped . This new model just hit the market earlier in the month at $280, with this first-time deal giving you a 46% markdown that is much larger than we usually see right out the gate, giving you $130 savings.
You can learn all about this new security camera’s features here .
Autel’s AC Home level 2 50A EV MaxiCharger provides up to 37 miles per hour from $426 (Reg. $569)
Autel’s official Amazon storefront is currently offering its MaxiCharger AC Home Hardwired Level 2 50A EV Charger starting from $426 shipped in its Sierra Blue colorway, while its Wood Grain, Silver, and Dark Grey colorways start from higher rates. Down from $569, since the start of July we’ve been seeing discounts keeping it higher at $499, including during the fall Prime Day event, though we have seen it go as low as $398 in 2026, which was last seen in June. The deal here cuts a solid $143 off the going rate, landing it just $28 above its all-time lowest tracked price.
